title: Norm Provenance Ledger: a pre-registered measurement of told, held, yielded and agent-authored norms in LLM agent logs
description: Rubric, scripts, pre-registration with amendments, judge outputs and results of a pre-registered study of how LLM agents receive, keep, break, yield on and invent behavioural norms. Tested on 101 transcripts: customer-service dialogues with policy conflicts (tau2-bench) and multi-agent software teams (MAST-Data), each coded by two LLM judges. The repository rebuilds the full pipeline from public sources and reproduces every reported number. Source transcripts are not redistributed; they are downloaded from their public hosts and verified by SHA-256.
